monsters.name: Scarecrow
monsters.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, unconscious

actions.name: Fearsome Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage, and the target has the frightened condition until the end of the scarecrow's next turn.

actions.name: Terrifying Glare
actions.desc: The scarecrow targets one creature it can see within 30 ft. of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of the scarecrow's next turn. While frightened in this way, the target is paralyzed.

actions.name: Constricting Vine
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns, and the blight can’t use Constricting Vine on another target.

actions.name: Entangling Plants (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The blight casts Entangle (spell save DC 12), using Constitution as its spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The blight has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the blight’s allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The dryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.desc: The dryad can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dryad makes one Vine Lash or Thorn Burst attack, and it can use Spellcasting to cast Charm Monster.

actions.name: Vine Lash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Thorn Burst
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The dryad casts spells using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14). No material components are required.

At Will: Animal Friendship, Charm Monster (lasts 24 hours; ends early if cast again), Druidcraft
1/Day Each: Entangle, Pass without Trace

bonus_actions.name: Tree Stride
bonus_actions.desc: If within 5 ft. of a Large or bigger tree, the dryad can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of a second Large or bigger tree that is within 60 ft. of the previous tree.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The wolf has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is knocked prone.

actions.name: Ram
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the elk moved 20 or more feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage and has the Prone condition.

traits.name: Bloodied Fury
traits.desc: The boar has Advantage on melee attack rolls while it is Bloodied.

actions.name: Gore
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the boar moved 20 or more feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The owlbear makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.

actions.name: Vine Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Verdant Wisp
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (3d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The druid casts spells using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13).

At Will: Druidcraft, Speak with Animals
2/Day Each: Entangle, Thunderwave
1/Day Each: Animal Messenger, Longstrider, Moonbeam
